# NS2 CPU / frame-time batch — 2026-11-01

This checkpoint keeps the last green NS2 renderer/compatibility stack and layers the validated CPU-side batch used for the next MKW frame-time comparison.

- Tight pure-Increasing DMA engine runs are consumed in one parser loop (`EDEN_NX2_DMA_INC_RUN=0` disables the fast path for A/B testing).
- Split-engine routing is cached once per Increasing run while preserving Maxwell/Kepler front-macro handlers, DMA segments, `is_last_call`, semaphore-watch diagnostics, and original fallbacks.
- Vulkan graphics/compute descriptor scratch vectors retain per-thread capacity but clear/rebuild their contents every configure call.
- Texture sampler IDs use graphics/compute descriptor-indexed vectors rather than a tagged-index hash lookup; descriptor memory is still read every configure call.
- Texture image-view IDs use the same direct indexed cache model, with descriptor-table invalidation forcing refresh before stale entries can be consumed.
- Joined/replaced texture images inherit `dma_downloaded`, so memory that already paid the first DMA-download synchronization does not spuriously pay it again after remapping.

All five additions passed the integrated core, PokeDinner, late, stability/frontier, and exact-source-capture checks before promotion to `ns2-pokopia`.

The experimental contiguous split-ring batch remains off the production branch/default path until MKW DMA run-length telemetry justifies changing publication cadence.
